newsitem.title: UK: IPE natgas sees good March trade with depth to bid.
newsitem.headline: IPE natgas sees good March trade with depth to bid.

text.p: IPE natural gas futures saw a sudden burst of March trade on Tuesday morning, just two days before the contract closes.
As well as an unusually large volume of trade concluded in March, 185 lots, there was also a single bid for 540 lots at 9.50 pence a therm.

"This was then supplanted by a bid for 10 lots at a higher level, but it'll be interesting to see if it's still there at two o'clock. There could be some fireworks then." said a futures broker. The afternoon session of the gas contract runs from 1400 GMT to 1600 GMT.

"We could see quite a volatile March," the broker said. He pointed out that the delivery month for the March contract, the first since the natural gas futures contract was launched, starts on Saturday and could lead to an interesting test of the system if there is an unexpectedly large volume to be delivered.

The rest of the forward curve was disappointing, with only 25 lots traded in total. While last week much of the futures interest centred around June, July and August, so far this week there has been a concentration on the prompt months. But trade on all contracts except March has so far been thin on both Monday and Tuesday morning.
